propositions: The supports_temperature override table is missing the default model claude-opus-4-8 and both global.* and us.* prefix variants, leaving them unguarded when temperature is configured, causing 400 ValidationException errors

Temperature parameter is deprecated for the entire claude-opus line on Bedrock (opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 with both us. and global. prefixes), not just opus-4-7, requiring the override table to be extended to cover all variants

The direct-anthropic provider path (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) also lacks the temperature override, causing pydantic-ai to silently drop the parameter instead of failing; greedy Pass-2 verification runs without the intended determinism guarantee

The override table comment and design are incomplete: the rejection occurs only when temperature is set to non-default values (0.0 or 0.5), while temp=1.0 succeeds, indicating a tunability deprecation rather than unsupported parameter
The top_p sampling parameter is also deprecated on the same model family but lacks a supports_top_p override entry, creating a latent defect when rebar begins sending top_p values
